#### `ARGON-D1-ADV-001` — Defective `HelpCatalog` implementations returning non-`CommandSpec` objects without `.name` raise `AttributeError` before `HelpData` raises `TypeError`
- **Severity:** `advisory`
- **Affected Files / Modules:** [pilot.py](file:///Users/chuckrussell/Dev/gendev/agent-framework/packages/friday-commands/src/friday_commands/pilot.py#L72-L78) (`describe_help`)
- **Violated Authority / Requirement:** None ([pilot-command-contract.md](file:///Users/chuckrussell/Dev/gendev/agent-framework/docs/planning/active/command-refactor/pilot-command-contract.md#L53-L66) `PC-01` requires port exceptions to propagate and `HelpData` enforces exact `CommandSpec` membership).
- **Evidence:** In [`describe_help`](file:///Users/chuckrussell/Dev/gendev/agent-framework/packages/friday-commands/src/friday_commands/pilot.py#L73-L78), general help executes `sorted(catalog.specs(), key=lambda spec: spec.name)` prior to `HelpData(commands)` and focused help accesses `spec.name` prior to `HelpData((spec,), focused_name=spec.name)`. If a buggy custom `HelpCatalog` violates its protocol by returning `(123,)` or `123`, `.name` lookup raises `AttributeError`, whereas returning a `CommandSpec` subclass raises `TypeError` inside `HelpData`.
- **Problem and Risk:** Inconsistent exception class (`AttributeError` vs `TypeError`) only when a caller supplies a protocol-violating catalog implementation; no invalid element can ever enter `CommandOutcome`.
- **Bounded Optional Mitigation:** Optionally snapshot/validate via `HelpData` before sorting or check `type(spec) is CommandSpec` before reading `spec.name` if uniform `TypeError` on broken third-party catalogs is desired in a future unit.
- **Required Tests / Verification:** None required for D1 conformance.
- **Documentation / Configuration Impact:** None.
